label: rem:recursive-atom-knot-atlas-interpretation
title: Provenance of the recursive atom-knot atlas entries
html:
Archimedean specialisation and table provenance. The quantitative benchmark rows in the five Master Reference Tables and the bounded summary and per-element tables of the atlas registry are generated deterministically from four mathematical and empirical inputs, whereas the narrative closure gallery and quarantined historical light-nuclide knot labels are static records:

  1. Canonical motif registry (Confined particle). Fixes the normal-form braid or Hecke element T_w for each elementary constituent; for the proton and neutron, the Borromean closure \widehat{(\sigma_1\sigma_2^{-1})^3} = \mathcal{B}_3 is a genuine three-strand braid closure (principled-derivation).
  2. Hyperbolic period evaluation. For cusped hyperbolic link closures (\mathcal{B}_3 and 4_1), evaluates exact Clausen dilogarithm volumes \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}} at \ge 80 decimal digits inside arbitrary-precision arithmetic.
  3. Hook--content Schur and Markov weights. Evaluates exact rational central weights y_\lambda(q) \in \mathbb{Q}(q) of Hans Wenzl [wenzl1988] at the canonical loop parameter z = q^3/(q^2+1).
  4. Methodology provenance and empirical reference tables. Attaches each row's epistemic methodology tag (principled-derivation, principled-gb-nf, or manual-historical-volume-match) and propagates (m_e, \mathfrak{D}_\beta, m_{\pi^\pm}) calibration uncertainties via the 80-digit Fréchet--Jacobian determinant (calibration and Jacobian protocol) against CODATA 2022 [codata2022], S. Navas and the Particle Data Group [pdg2024], and the AME 2020 atomic mass tables of Meng Wang, W. J. Huang, F. G. Kondev, Georges Audi, and Sarah Naimi [ame2020tables]. Outside the generated tables, the three light-nuclide identifications tagged manual-historical-volume-match ({}^2\mathrm{H} \leftrightarrow 6_2, {}^3\mathrm{H} \leftrightarrow 8_{11}, {}^3\mathrm{He} \leftrightarrow L_{6a4}) are hand-recorded historical volume matches rather than closures derived from the multi-nucleon Hecke element (whose averaged inter-nucleon crossings lie outside the braid-group image), and carry no binding prediction in the canonical tables.
